        <version>2.5</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>

</project>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

  <parent>
    <groupId>org.sonatype.oss</groupId>
    <artifactId>oss-parent</artifactId>

  <groupId>com.google.auto</groupId>
  <artifactId>auto-parent</artifactId>
  <packaging>pom</packaging>
  <version>3</version>

content.text:
Now I found the root cause. The `compile-testing` library (versions 0.6, 0.7, 0.8) has a system-scoped dependency on `com.sun:tools` which uses `${toolsjar}` as the system path. This was needed for Java 8 and earlier where `tools.jar` was a separate file. In Java 9+, `tools.jar` was removed and its classes were integrated into the JDK modules.

The system is running Java 11 where `tools.jar` doesn't exist. The fix is to exclude the `com.sun:tools` transitive dependency from `compile-testing` in each module's POM.

Let me also check if there are any additional compilation errors after resolving the tools.jar issue by trying a quick test.

Since Maven defaults to Java 11 (which has no javac), but we can fix it via `JAVA_HOME`. However, the approach should be to fix the POM files. Let me figure out the right strategy:

The core problem is that the `compile-testing` library (0.6, 0.7, 0.8) has `com.sun:tools` as a system-scoped dependency. On Java 9+, `tools.jar` doesn't exist. The fix is to exclude this transitive dependency from `compile-testing` in each module, and add a JDK 9+ profile that doesn't require it.

For the parent POM, we need to add a profile for Java 9+ that either provides an empty tools dependency or adjusts the `toolsjar` property.

Let me now write the analysis and fixes.

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
  xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/maven-v4_0_0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>com.google.auto</groupId>
    <artifactId>auto-parent</artifactId>
    <version>3</version>
  </parent>

  <groupId>com.google.auto.value</groupId>
  <artifactId>auto-value</artifactId>
  <version>1.2-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <name>AutoValue</name>
  <description>
    Immutable value-type code generation for Java 1.6+.
  </description>

  <properties>
    <guava.version>18.0</guava.version>
  </properties>
  <scm>
    <url>http://github.com/google/auto</url>
    <connection>scm:git:git://github.com/google/auto.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:ssh://git@github.com/google/auto.git</developerConnection>
    <tag>HEAD</tag>
  </scm>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.auto</groupId>
      <artifactId>auto-common</artifactId>
      <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.auto.service</groupId>
      <artifactId>auto-service</artifactId>
      <version>1.0-rc2</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.guava</groupId>
      <artifactId>guava</artifactId>
      <version>${guava.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.ow2.asm</groupId>
      <artifactId>asm</artifactId>
      <version>4.1</version>
    </dependency>
    <!-- test dependencies -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.apache.velocity</groupId>
      <artifactId>velocity</artifactId>
      <version>1.7</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.guava</groupId>
      <artifactId>guava-testlib</artifactId>
      <version>${guava.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.testing.compile</groupId>
      <artifactId>compile-testing</artifactId>
      <version>0.6</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
      <version>4.11</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.truth</groupId>
      <artifactId>truth</artifactId>
      <version>0.25</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <resources>
      <resource>
        <directory>src/main/java</directory>
      </resource>
    </resources>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>2.5</version>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-invoker-plugin</artifactId>
        <configuration>
          <addTestClassPath>true</addTestClassPath>
          <cloneProjectsTo>${project.build.directory}/it</cloneProjectsTo>
          <filterProperties>
            <auto.version>${project.version}</auto.version>
          </filterProperties>
          <pomIncludes>
            <pomInclude>*/pom.xml</pomInclude>
          </pomIncludes>
          <streamLogs>true</streamLogs>
        </configuration>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <id>integration-test</id>
            <goals>
              <goal>install</goal>
              <goal>run</goal>
            </goals>
          </execution>
        </executions>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.immutables.tools</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>3</version>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <phase>package</phase>
            <goals>
              <goal>shade</goal>
            </goals>
            <configuration>
              <minimizeJar>true</minimizeJar>
              <relocations>
                <relocation>
                  <pattern>org.objectweb</pattern>
                  <shadedPattern>autovalue.shaded.org.objectweb$</shadedPattern>
                </relocation>
                <relocation>
                  <pattern>com.google</pattern>
                  <shadedPattern>autovalue.shaded.com.google$</shadedPattern>
                  <excludes>
                    <exclude>com.google.auto.value.**</exclude>
                  </excludes>
                </relocation>
              </relocations>
            </configuration>
          </execution>
        </executions>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>

BUILD FAILURE ANALYSIS
=====================

Repository: google/auto
Location: /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto/
Build system: Maven 3.6.3
Java runtime: OpenJDK 11.0.27 (JRE only, no javac)
Build entry point: build-pom.xml (aggregator for all modules)

MODULES:
  - common  (auto-common 1.0-SNAPSHOT)
  - factory (auto-factory 1.0-SNAPSHOT)
  - service (auto-service 1.0-SNAPSHOT)
  - value   (auto-value 1.2-SNAPSHOT)

ROOT CAUSE:
===========
All four modules fail with the same dependency resolution error:

  "Could not find artifact com.sun:tools:jar:11.0.27 at specified path
   /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/../lib/tools.jar"

This is caused by a Java version incompatibility:
1. The project was designed for Java 6/7/8 (as seen in .travis.yml: oraclejdk7, openjdk7)
2. The current environment runs Java 11 (OpenJDK 11.0.27)
3. In Java 9+, tools.jar was removed (classes moved into jdk.compiler module)

DEPENDENCY CHAIN:
  compile-testing (0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
    -> com.sun:tools:jar:${java.version} (system scope, systemPath=${toolsjar})

  The compile-testing library declares a system-scoped dependency on com.sun:tools
  using ${toolsjar} which resolves to ${java.home}/../lib/tools.jar.
  On Java 11, this file does not exist.

AFFECTED MODULE POM FILES AND THEIR compile-testing VERSIONS:
  - common/pom.xml:  compile-testing 0.7 (test scope)
  - service/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.6 (test scope)
  - factory/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.8 (test scope)
  - value/pom.xml:   compile-testing 0.6 (test scope)

ADDITIONAL ISSUE FOR value MODULE:
  value/pom.xml depends on auto-common:1.0-SNAPSHOT which is the local
  common module. This SNAPSHOT is not available in remote repos, so
  common must be built (mvn install) first. This is handled by the
  build-pom.xml aggregator which builds modules in the right order.

FIX STRATEGY:
=============
1. In the root pom.xml (auto-parent), add a JDK 9+ profile that:
   - Sets toolsjar property to empty/noop since tools.jar doesn't exist
   - Updates source/target to 1.7 (minimum for Java 11 cross-compilation)

2. In each module POM that depends on compile-testing, exclude the
   com.sun:tools transitive dependency:
   - common/pom.xml
   - service/pom.xml
   - factory/pom.xml
   - value/pom.xml

3. Update java.version property from 1.6 to 1.7 in the root pom.xml,
   since Java 11's javac doesn't support source/target 1.6.

PATCHES NEEDED:
  patch_1.diff - Root pom.xml: Add JDK 9+ profile, update java.version
  patch_2.diff - common/pom.xml: Exclude com.sun:tools from compile-testing
  patch_3.diff - service/pom.xml: Exclude com.sun:tools from compile-testing
  patch_4.diff - factory/pom.xml: Exclude com.sun:tools from compile-testing
  patch_5.diff - value/pom.xml: Exclude com.sun:tools from compile-testing
